title: JSON workflow state and instruction injection

decisionLog.decision: Tracking state moves to committed `.lessmess/workflow/` JSON (gitignore negation); rest of `.lessmess/` stays personal. User-confirmed baseline.
Plan/task prose stays markdown under `changes/<id>/`, referenced from JSON; task frontmatter dropped (identity is JSON-only).
Workflow instructions become binary-embedded JSON modules injected at spawn, deterministic selection f(session kind, change/task state); static selection v1; no per-repo overrides.
Docs system (STRUCTURE.md/AGENTS.md learnings pairs) out of scope except the workflow_agents.md asset swap and natural gardening.

JSI-00: index.json is a pure registry (no status/dates) — overall status and update dates are authoritative only in each ChangeState, removing today's root-ledger dual-write. Empty values are omitted (`omitempty`), not stored as `—`.

JSI-02: `Open` distinguishes `ErrLegacyMarkdown` (md ledgers without JSON state → run migrate) from `ErrNoChanges` (fresh → setup mode); serve/validate auto-migrate via `store.MigrateIfNeeded` before opening.

JSI-02: the ledger detail surfaces (`LedgerFile`, `ContainerLedgerFile`) became deterministic generated-markdown views over the JSON state (classic pinned tables), so existing modal/`app.js` link shapes keep working; JSI-05 shrinks to view polish and sweeps. `docs.Init` bootstrap moved to the JSON index (pulled forward from JSI-06).

JSI-02: unresolved index entries are validation violations, not changes (`Change()` → `ErrNotFound`); empty containers are tracked by their real prose dir (`HasContainer` = children OR existing container); `MoveTask` validates against fresh state first (corrupt state → `ErrInvalid`, not `ErrNotFound`) and preserves legacy group-append insertion semantics.

JSI-04: instruction modules live in `internal/server/instructions.json` (embedded, `go:embed`) covering the agent-facing session primes (discussion, change.session, change.handoff, worktree, closeout, task.session); gardener/explorer/commit/repoCommit prompts remain Go-composed — already binary-versioned and never resident in AGENTS.md, so the injection goal holds for them by construction. Primes inject the generated state view; spawns log + record module IDs; `GET /workflow/instructions` serves the manifest.
JSI-06: root AGENTS.md is a 30-line pointer above the untouched learnings (stale learnings left to close-time gardening per plan); the drift-pin test is kept, now pinning the pointer text.
